query:
SELECT 
  id,
  userId,
  month,
  year,
  rent,
  salaries,
  electricity,
  others,
  createdAt,
  DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m') as created_month
FROM overhead_costs
WHERE userId = 1
ORDER BY year DESC, month DESC;
